steps.label: 01-explanation
steps.body:
旧规则存档不兼容 / Old save is incompatible

新版图鉴只统计有正式获得来源的永久收藏。旧版把租借队登记为已拥有，无法可靠转换。请先备份旧存档，再重新开始。

The new Pokedex counts permanent acquisitions. This older save recorded rentals as owned and cannot be converted reliably. Download a backup before starting over.

下载原始存档 / DOWNLOAD BACKUP
清除并重新开始 / START FRESH
